title: Head Data Scientist
description:
Role & responsibilities
The Head Data Scientist will own Data Science strategy, delivery quality, and production outcomes for the AI CoE. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for setting modeling and evaluation standards, driving measurable business impact, and ensuring solutions are production-grade, governed, and Responsible-AI aligned.
You will lead a team of 8 to 10 Data Scientists and coordinate partner resources where applicable, working closely with AI Product, AI Architecture, Data Engineering, MLOps, Cloud, and Security/IRM teams to deliver scalable and reliable AI capabilities.
Retail domain expertise is a must; Oil & Energy is a strong plus.
Key Responsibilities
1) DS Strategy, Standards & Quality Gates
Define the Data Science vision, modeling standards, and reusable playbooks across AI/advanced analytics and GenAI initiatives.
Establish evaluation frameworks, benchmarking approaches, and quality gates for production readiness (performance thresholds, stability checks, monitoring requirements, retraining triggers).
Build reusable assets: feature engineering patterns, experiment templates, model documentation packs, and governance artifacts.
2) End-to-End Delivery Leadership (Hands-on Oversight)
Lead problem framing with business stakeholders: objectives, constraints, assumptions, success metrics, and value hypotheses.
Oversee end-to-end DS delivery: EDA, feature strategy, modeling, tuning, validation, and readiness for deployment.
Ensure strong experimentation discipline: baselines, ablations, reproducibility, and robust testing for edge cases and data shifts.
3) Advanced Modeling Excellence
Drive excellence across predictive modeling: classification, regression, time-series/forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation/clustering, and recommendation/personalization patterns.
Guide optimization/decision-support components where required, ensuring pragmatic assumptions and measurable outcomes.
Lead model selection and trade-offs across accuracy, interpretability, latency, scalability, and cost.
4) Production Readiness, Governance & Responsible AI
Establish DS governance: documentation standards, interpretability/explainability where required, bias/fairness checks, privacy and sensitive-data handling, and model risk documentation.
Ensure enterprise readiness with Security/IRM: auditability, traceability, approvals, environment discipline, and release evidence.
Define monitoring strategy and operating cadence: drift/quality/latency, business KPI impact, incident handling inputs, and retraining plans.
5) GenAI, Agentic AI Analytics & Evaluation (Where Applicable)
Define evaluation strategy for LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI system outputs: quality metrics, relevance, grounding, hallucination checks, task completion accuracy, safety signals, and feedback loops.
Drive structured testing and release gating evidence for GenAI and autonomous/agent-based AI systems, including human-in-the-loop evaluation where required.
Establish performance monitoring frameworks to assess agent decision flows, tool usage effectiveness, multi-step reasoning accuracy, and reliability in real-world scenarios.
6) Cross-Functional Delivery & Stakeholder Leadership
Partner with Data Engineering to ensure AI-ready datasets, labels, feature availability, data quality standards, and refresh SLAs.
Partner with MLOps/Platform to ensure deployability: model packaging/serving expectations, monitoring telemetry, and retraining automation triggers.
Provide clear leadership updates: progress, risks, mitigation, dependencies, and value realization tracking.
7) People Leadership (Team + Partners)
Lead and mentor a team of 810 Data Scientists; guide performance, capability building, and delivery accountability.
Coordinate partner resources where applicable to ensure quality, velocity, and adherence to standards.
Set strong engineering and DS practices: code reviews, documentation, experiment tracking, and knowledge sharing.

Preferred candidate profile

B.Tech./B.E. or Master’s in Statistics, AI, Economics, Mathematics (or related field) with strong R&D/research experience; PhD in Statistics/AI (or equivalent) is highly preferred.
12–15+ years in Data Science/Applied ML, including 5+ years leading teams/pods and owning production outcomes.
Strong hands-on depth in statistics and ML, with rigorous evaluation practices (AUC/F1, precision/recall, calibration, lift, forecasting metrics, stability testing; causal thinking where relevant).
Proven expertise in feature engineering, experiment design, model selection, and translating business problems into deployable ML solutions.
Production mindset: monitoring/drift strategy, retraining approach, model risk management, and strong documentation discipline.
Strong Python (and working SQL); experience with modern data/AI platforms (Databricks preferred) and large-scale datasets.
Strong stakeholder management and communication across business, engineering, and governance teams.
Retail domain expertise (Must); Oil & Energy (big plus).
Authored whitepapers, publications, or patents in applied ML/AI (preferred).

Why Join Jio-bp AI CoE
Opportunity to build and shape an enterprise-grade AI/GenAI platform on Azure Databricks from the ground up.
Work at the intersection of energy, mobility, and digital innovation with high-visibility, high-impact programs.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to RIL’s broader AI transformation agenda.
Be a core builder of the AI CoE foundation, driving measurable business value across Jio-bp operations.

x4 typical NVMe, lane reversal/polarity, width detection & recovery from degraded width

long resume latencies (client)
link instability under load (enterprise)

description:
About the Opportunity: Lead Data Engineer
Who we are:
A leading Data and Analytics company in the Financial Services and Insurance (FSI) industry. We are trusted by the world's largest FSIs, including insurers, banks, AMCs, and NBFCs, to address their data challenges. Our clients include 40+ enterprises with over $10B in deposits/AUM, collectively representing about 1B customers globally.
Our expertise lies in creating next-gen data technology products to help FSI enterprises organize, manage, and effectively use data. We have consistently challenged the status quo, introducing many industry-firsts like the first enterprise data platform in Asia on cloud for a regulated entity. Founded in 2013, the company has now completed a decade of innovation, backed by Info Edge Ventures (a JV between Temasek Holdings of Singapore and Naukri) and US-based Season 2 Ventures.

Our Culture:
At this high-growth data and analytics company, we strive to create a community of passionate data professionals who aim to transcend the usual corporate dynamics. We offer you the freedom to ideate, commit, and navigate your career trajectory at your own pace.
Culture of ownership: Empowerment to drive outcomes.
Our culture encourages 'Tech Poetry' combining creativity and technology to create solutions that revolutionize industry.
We trust our people to manage their responsibilities with minimal policy constraints.
Our team is composed of the industry's brightest minds, from PhDs and engineers to industry specialists from Banking, Insurance, NBFCs, AMCs, who will challenge and inspire you to reach new heights.

Job Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will not only design and develop our cloud-based data infrastructure but also lead a team of Data Engineers to deliver robust and scalable data solutions for our BFSI customers. As a Tech Lead, you will work at the intersection of cloud technologies, data engineering, and the BFSI domain, while guiding the team to ensure project success.

Key Responsibilities:
Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Data Engineers to deliver high-quality data solutions.
Design, develop, and implement cloud-based data pipelines, ETL processes, and data integration solutions using platforms like AWS.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and design scalable data models and architectures that align with BFSI industry needs.
Optimize data storage, processing, and retrieval for maximum performance and cost efficiency in cloud environments.
Implement data security and compliance measures to ensure the protection and integrity of sensitive BFSI data.
Work closely with data scientists and analysts to enable seamless access to high-quality data for analytical purposes.
Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, ensuring data availability and reliability for BFSI customers.
Stay updated on industry best practices, emerging cloud technologies, and trends in the BFSI sector to drive continuous improvement and innovation.
Manage project timelines, delegate tasks, and ensure the successful delivery of data engineering projects.

Qualifications:
Minimum 6 years experience with good hands-on PySpark, Airflow, AWS.
Advanced SQL and PySpark expertise; strong understanding of Data Engineering concepts (DW, Data Lake, OLTP vs OLAP, etc.).
API development experience (preferably in Python).
Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with Airflow.
Exposure to Hudi, Iceberg, or Delta Lake.
